meta.notes: SD3.5 Large uses triple text encoding (CLIP-L + CLIP-G + T5-XXL). The interception prompt (translated to English by Stage 3) is passed through unchanged to all three encoders — the regular SD3 path (paper Fig. 2a): the CLIP encoders anchor the global gist, T5 carries the full-length detail beyond CLIP's 77-token window. No per-encoder keyword splitting.
